papers.title: Paged KV Cache Scheduling for Low-Latency LLM Serving
papers.abstract: We introduce a new KV cache scheduling approach for LLM serving. We evaluate it against strong baselines on multiple GPU workloads and report 1.8x throughput with lower tail latency and memory use. Ablation studies describe the source of the improvement.

papers.title: Elastic GPU Scheduling for Multi-Tenant AI Clusters
papers.abstract: We propose an elastic GPU scheduling system for multi-tenant distributed training and inference. Evaluation on production-inspired traces compares several baselines and improves utilization by 24 percent while preserving service level objectives.
